item.title: The 7 D.C. Restaurants You Need to Take Your Foodie Friend
item.dc:creator: Margaret Cole
item.description: My favorite places to eat in Washington, D.C.
item.content:encoded:
As someone who self-identifies as a huge foodie, Washington D.C. has been the biggest blessing on my palate. I lost count a long time ago of how many restaurants I’ve tried since moving here, but the thing I do remember is which ones were an A+ dining experience. So here is your guide to all of the best restaurants in Washington D.C. If I missed any, feel free to let me know so I can put them on my list of where to go next!

Perry’s

Perry’s is a Japanese fusion restaurant in Adams Morgan. The appetizers are insane, especially the Amazake Focaccia and the Karaage Fried Chicken. You literally cannot go wrong with anything on this menu.

Moon Rabbit

This is the most elegant Vietnamese restaurant you will ever go to. The dishes are literal works of art. Every ingredient is clearly intentionally chosen and the service is immaculate. You must try the summer roll.

Your Only Friend

This was the post-marathon meal I picked months in advance. These sandwiches are to die for. You have to try the Chicky Pep No. 2.

Rasika

Fun fact, President Obama has had multiple of his birthdays here. Rasika is an elegant, artistic Indian restaurant. The Palak Chaat is to die for.

Zaytinya

Zaytinya is a modern Mediterranean restaurant. The ambiance is exciting yet tasteful. I have come back here so many times, and the thing I always order is simply the hummus.

Unconventional Diner

Think of your classic local diner. Unconventional Diner is simply the elevated version. The dishes are mouth-watering, the coffee drinks delectable, and the service is excellent. There are so many comfort foods to try on this menu, but the one I would recommend for your first time is the chicken and waffles.

Bistro Du Jour

Right along the water on the Wharf, Bistro Du Jour is the perfect brunch place to take your friends who are visiting for the weekend. You have to sit outside to get the full experience. I have gone here multiple times and my favorite dish by far is the salmon crogel (croissant-bagel).
